### Uzzah’s Error
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/uzzahs-error
Passage: 2 Samuel 6:6-7
Points:
- Severe instances of divine judgment reveal God's unchanging holiness, which the New Testament reaffirms rather than contradicts.
- Uzzah and the Israelites disregarded explicit divine commands by moving the ark on an oxcart instead of on priestly shoulders.
- Well-meaning intentions do not justify disobedience to God's revealed law.
- The real wonder is not that God occasionally executes immediate wrath, but that He exercises gracious restraint toward daily human sin.

### Day 46: 2 Samuel 6:1–11
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-46-2-samuel-6-111.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 6:9
Points:
- David patterned his transport of the ark after the Philistines rather than following God's biblical instructions for the priests.
- Uzzah’s sudden death plunged an exuberant celebration into immediate disaster, exposing whether faith was grounded in God's holy character.
- The judgment was not an act of divine harshness, but a reminder of God's absolute holiness.
- God desires to bless His people, but genuine reverence and obedience to His Word are the necessary channels for that blessing.
